name: News
description: News / press / events section over hand-authored items with fixed categories (Projekt, Auszeichnung, Presse, Termin). Layouts: filterable teaser grid, magazine (1 featured + 4 side items), filtered list with date markers, featured + compact list, or a timeline with year tabs.
when_to_use: Company news, press mentions, and dates on marketing pages. Items are authored inline — use Teaser when entries should come from a record type instead.
capabilities: client-side category filters (grid/list) and year tabs (timeline)
category badge, date, author, and external source per item
magazine and featured layouts highlight the first item
optional 'see all' link in the header row

variants.description: 3-column teaser cards with category filters. Default.
One featured item left + 4 smaller side items.
Rows with date markers and category filters.
One featured card + compact list beside it.
Chronological rows grouped behind year tabs.

breakpoints.mobile: Single column; filters and year tabs wrap.
breakpoints.desktop: 3-column grid; magazine/featured split into featured + side column.

ai.prompt_summary: News: press/news section. Settings: variant (grid|magazine|list|featured|timeline), eyebrow, headline, intro, head_align (left|center), see_all_label (e.g. 'Alle News →'), see_all_to. Items in items[] (min 1): { title (required), excerpt, date, category (Projekt|Auszeichnung|Presse|Termin), author, is_press_release (PR badge), source (external outlet), image, link }.
ai.content_guidelines: 5-8 items with varied categories and descending dates. Excerpts 1-2 sentences. Set source only for external press coverage.

field_hints.items.category: One of the four fixed values — they double as filter labels.
field_hints.items.is_press_release: Adds a PR badge; combine with source for external coverage.
field_hints.see_all_label: Top-right header link; leave empty to hide.
